name: LexSocket - European Public Procurement
description: Search and explore European public procurement tenders — both EU above-threshold (TED) and below-threshold from 18 national sources. Find construction projects, IT services contracts, and procurement opportunities across Europe with hybrid search, CPV/NUTS filtering, and buyer lookup.

tools.name: search_ted
tools.description: Hybrid search across EU above-threshold procurement tenders with filtering by country, CPV, NUTS, value range, and dates.

tools.name: search_ted_fts
tools.description: Full-text keyword search (BM25) for exact term matching in TED notices.

tools.name: search_ted_semantic
tools.description: Semantic vector search to find TED tenders by meaning and context.

tools.name: get_ted_notice
tools.description: Retrieve a complete TED notice by its ID, including full XML content.

tools.name: get_ted_stats
tools.description: Get TED database statistics: row count, storage size, embedding coverage.

tools.name: find_similar_ted_tenders
tools.description: Find TED tenders similar to a given notice using stored embedding vectors.

tools.name: browse_ted_by_deadline
tools.description: Browse TED tenders sorted by submission deadline with optional filters.

tools.name: search_ted_by_buyer
tools.description: Search TED notices by contracting authority / buyer name.

tools.name: search_ted_by_cpv
tools.description: Search TED notices by CPV code with prefix matching.

tools.name: search_ted_by_nuts
tools.description: Search TED notices by NUTS region code with prefix matching.

tools.name: search_ted_by_value_range
tools.description: Search TED notices within an estimated contract value range.

tools.name: get_ted_statistics
tools.description: Get aggregated TED statistics grouped by procurement type, country, currency, or NUTS region.

tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Hybrid search across below-threshold national tenders from 11 countries (FR, GB, DE, ES, IT, NL, IE, PT, DK, PL, AT).

tools.name: get_tender
tools.description: Retrieve a specific national tender by its ID, including raw JSON.

tools.name: get_open_opportunities
tools.description: Get currently active/open tenders for bid/no-bid analysis.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Get national tenders database statistics.

tools.name: find_similar_tenders
tools.description: Find national tenders similar to a given tender using stored embeddings.

tools.name: browse_by_deadline
tools.description: Browse national tenders sorted by submission deadline.

tools.name: search_by_buyer
tools.description: Search national tenders by contracting authority / buyer name.

tools.name: search_by_cpv
tools.description: Search national tenders by CPV code.

tools.name: search_by_nuts
tools.description: Search national tenders by NUTS region code.

tools.name: search_by_value_range
tools.description: Search national tenders by estimated contract value range.

tools.name: get_tender_statistics
tools.description: Get aggregated national tender statistics by country, status, source, etc.
